entries.reason: ENQ RESOURCE(NCS-CUST-NO-NAME) LENGTH(16) carries no NOSUSPEND, so a held resource suspends the task instead of returning ENQBUSY (the model refuses a planned-busy ENQ without NOSUSPEND), and the 16-byte length equals the name's size (CBSACUST + 6-byte sort code + 2 filler), so LENGERR and INVREQ are not raised either: RESP is always NORMAL.
DEQ RESOURCE(NCS-CUST-NO-NAME) LENGTH(16) follows the ENQ of the same 16-byte name in the same task, so the resource is held and the length matches: the DEQ always completes NORMAL.
